What to record: Identify room, cabinet, assembly ID, and released revision.
Record the person responsible and assembly date or shift.
List the parts and material group entering the operation.
State the face, edge, datum, drawing note, or tolerance used.
Example: Front edges flush / diagonals within 1 mm

What to record: Record IDs, hinge model, plate, door thickness, and opening geometry.
Record cup diameter, depth, edge setback, vertical locations, and pilot sizes.
Record target and actual overlay, paired gap, top, and bottom reveals.
Record screw adjustments, opening angle, collision, soft close, and final signoff.
